approved_decisions.SOC-1: Retain professional social-profile URLs explicitly published on the official website.
approved_decisions.SOC-2: Keep person and organisation profile URLs separate and hold ambiguous attribution for review.
approved_decisions.SOC-3: Keep both URL fields optional for Farrier and Horse Owner.
approved_decisions.SOC-4: Do not open or extract linked social profiles automatically during the official-site check.
approved_decisions.SOC-5: Prefer an exact LinkedIn company URL for the future profile-search Actor; use verified company name plus target role as fallback.
approved_decisions.SOC-6: Route an individual LinkedIn profile URL to human review or a separately approved profile-scraper action.
approved_decisions.SOC-7: Keep broad social signals, followers, posts, connections and personal interests out of scope.
approved_decisions.SOC-8: Do not infer consent, outreach eligibility or buying influence from a social-profile URL.
